# Borrowing Pilot — Status

> Last reviewed: 2026-10-10. Source: [pilot ledger extract](sources/README.md) and the [7 October review](meetings/2026-10-07-pilot-review.md).

## Current objective

Complete the single-desk pilot without silently changing the seven-day term. Hand off a stable [borrowing policy](kb/borrowing-policy.md), a repeatable [reminder flow](kb/reminder-workflow.md), and a short [volunteer checklist](../handbook/check-in/README.md).

## What changed recently

The reminder trial ran on day five of each loan. The 7 October review kept it, but did not authorize a second automated message. Volunteers now read the due date aloud and mark it on the slip; two illegible slips prompted that change. The 10 October [snapshot](kb/pilot-metrics.md#10-october-snapshot) counts 35 of 37 matured loans returned on time.

## Blockers and risks

- Cross-branch returns are unresolved. Three borrowers asked about them; no transfer was processed.
- One volunteer has not completed the updated checklist walkthrough.
- The ledger uses a daily cutoff; entries after closing belong to the next snapshot.

## Next shift

Jo collects feedback from the Saturday handoff. Maya confirms the branch-return policy owner and records the answer against [A-06](actions.md#open-actions). No new process should be stated as approved until [decisions](decisions.md#decision-log) are updated.
